instruction: I am reading a lecture note in PDF while a music video is playing in VLC media player. I'd like to enable the minimal view interface in VLC to reduce visual clutter while studying. Could you help me change this setting in VLC preferences? I want to keep the lecture note open and focused.

parameters.window_name: lecture.pdf — 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Lecture 2: Data Structures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the VLC minimal view interface (qt-minimal-view=1). This is a similar single-setting configuration task to the original. The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_minimal_view metric function which reads the VLC config file and verifies that qt-minimal-view is set to 1.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads VLC config file from ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc
Metric (check_qt_minimal_view) correctly parses config file and checks qt-minimal-view setting
Metric handles default value correctly (defaults to '0' if setting not present)
Expected value (1) is semantically correct for enabling minimal view
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config is written to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (qt-minimal-view=1)
